## Selected Systems & Production Work

### 1. Vyay — AI Cost Engine
- **Category**: AI Infrastructure & Financial Auditing
- **Description**: AI cost-auditing platform that turns cloud and token usage into shareable reports.
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Supabase RLS, Gemini 2.5 Flash
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TarunyaProgrammer

### 2. Cabin — MaintainerOS
- **Category**: Local-first desktop workspace
- **Description**: Electron workspace bringing multi-repository context, local Git checkouts, DCO/CI checks, and AI-assisted reviews into one place.
- **Tech Stack**: Electron, React, TypeScript, SQLite
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TarunyaProgrammer/Cabin-MaintainerOS

### 3. GithubAnalyzer & WebiU
- **Category**: Edge Telemetry & Developer Analytics (GSoC '26 @ C2SI)
- **Description**: Edge-cached telemetry platform built for C2SI using Hono on Cloudflare Workers, reducing API overhead by 60% with webhook-driven pipelines.
- **Tech Stack**: Hono, Cloudflare Workers, NestJS, Angular, PostgreSQL, Docker
- **Repository**: https://github.com/TarunyaProgrammer/GithubAnalyzer-PreGsocTask

### 4. Other Shipped Systems
- **Echo**: Real-time bidirectional messaging platform built with Socket.IO, Node.js, and MongoDB.
- **Streakly**: Offline-first habit tracker using IndexedDB, service workers, and PWA architecture.
- **RFP-ResponseBuilder**: AI workflow pipeline generating structured, tender-compliant corporate proposals from technical specifications using Gemini API.
